description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Order by his Excellency the President for the maintenance of the Services essential to the life of the Community
categorisation: This gazette contains an order by the President declaring certain services as essential services under the Public Security Ordinance. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by modifying the application of existing legislation (Chapter 40) for public security purposes, which fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
